cloud_quick_model.description: Cloud model for the quick read (Android fallback / iOS vision) and hybrid text fallback

cloud_deep_model.description: Cloud model for the Deep Check escalation

grimace_alert_threshold.description: Pain score (0-10) at or above which a Deep Check runs and a vet is suggested

gemini_pain_offset.description: Points (0-5) added to Gemini's grimace total before the alert check. Gemini under-scores FGS pain by about 2.4/10 (Sci Rep 2025). Interim fix until a landmark-based scorer replaces Gemini.

cat_id_min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0-1) between photo embeddings for a cat to count as recognised. Placeholder: calibrate on real photos of look-alike cats.
